newsitem.title: USA: Prentiss Properties Trust Q1 FFO $0.54.
newsitem.headline: Prentiss Properties Trust Q1 FFO $0.54.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The company gives comparison figures from the fourth quarter of 1996. First quarter 1996 results were not immediately available.

NOTE: Funds from operations, or FFO, (before minority interest) were $12.7 million, or $0.54 per share, for the first quarter 1997. This compares to adjusted full fourth quarter 1996 FFO (before minority interest) of $11.5 million, or $0.49 per share.

The company said FFO was driven by continued strong performance of the company's core portfolio and its service business, as well as the impact of fourth quarter 1996 acquisitions ($120 million) and the properties acquired throughout the first quarter of 1997 ($38.2 million).
